name: LMDeploy
tagline: High-throughput local LLM serving and compression toolkit with TurboMind engine and OpenAI-compatible API.
real_test_summary: Tested serving quantized chat models locally via lmdeploy serve api_server with persistent KV cache. Delivers strong tokens-per-second throughput for local inference.
pros: TurboMind inference engine with efficient KV cache and quantization
Drop-in OpenAI-compatible server for local apps and agents
Apache-2.0 open-source license with Python and CLI tools
cons: Best performance targets Linux and supported GPU setups
More oriented toward local serving than casual desktop chat
